budget_note: Historical estimated-cost settings; review provider pricing before a new collection.
primary_metric: Equal-book mean strict accuracy difference; 10 books, paired within source group
inference: Two-sided exact enumeration of book-level sign flips; Holm across four primary comparisons; book-level t 95% CI. Symmetry and independence assumptions; fixed corpus.
failure_policy: No retries or repairs for malformed responses, truncation, refusal or wrong answers; strict accuracy scores these zero. Retry transient transport/server/rate errors at most twice total; exhausted transient errors are zero in strict operational accuracy and separately excluded in response-only sensitivity. Authentication/billing/configuration failures halt collection and are not model outcomes. No formal inference until all planned jobs resolved.
region: Official mainland-China BigModel endpoint and official DeepSeek endpoint; client timezone Asia/Shanghai. Actual serving datacenter region not independently available.
